subject: Action: Agree pilot acceptance criteria + infra access owners
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Brooks <hannah@fathomdata.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Action: Agree pilot acceptance criteria + infra access owners

Thanks for the time earlier, Hannah — good conversation. Quick recap and explicit next steps so we can kick off the pilot cleanly next week. Team, I'm copying the owners who will run operations and evaluation.

Key pain points you shared
- Latency spikes for production inferencing on bulk batch requests (95th percentile > 700ms)
- Fragmented prompt evaluation: inconsistent outputs across model variants and tokenization differences
- Need predictable per-request cost estimates for reporting to finance

Pilot goal (30 days): validate that Redwood inference reduces 95p latency to <250ms for representative requests while keeping prompt accuracy within a 3% delta vs current baseline.

Success metrics (proposal)
- Latency: 95th percentile <= 250ms for 512-token median requests measured across the test suite
- Quality: BLEU/ROUGE-style scoring on your prompt set — no more than 3% negative regression across the top-line prompts
- Cost: per-1k-token cost projection with our batching settings (we'll provide baseline and optimized runs)

Scope and constraints
- Data: we'll use the 10k-row test dataset you offered (synthetic subset) and a separate 500 prompt evaluation set you agreed to provide
- Model: start with the open Llama-3-13B variant you use in prod; we'll also test a quantized 8-bit variant if we need cost savings
- Network: pilot runs in Redwood hosted region (us-west) behind your SSO and egress controls; we will not persist customer PII beyond logs you permit

Owners & immediate asks
- Customer engineering: Hannah (primary), Eli (ops/security) — provide SSO metadata and test dataset by Tue 5/12
- Redwood ops: Marcus — provisioning and monitoring config; will share service account instructions by EOD Mon 5/11
- Redwood solutions: Priyom — evaluation plan and prompt set template; will drop Drive link and initial metrics dashboard

Access/setup steps (actionable)
1) Hannah: upload test dataset & prompt CSV to shared Drive folder (link below) and confirm security contact (security@fathomdata.com)
2) Eli: send SAML metadata or add our SP entry to your IdP; indicate any IP allowlist windows
3) Marcus: we will provision a dedicated trial pool and share a service account key + sandbox endpoint (no production traffic)
4) Priyom: will publish the prompt evaluation rubric and initial dashboard (Jira ticket and Drive attached)

Attachments referenced: pilot-moa-draft.docx (draft scope), fathom_pilot_prompt_set_v1.csv (template), redwood-poc-scope.pdf (technical runbook)

Proposed timeline
- Tue 5/11: infra provisioning + service account issued
- Wed 5/12: customer uploads dataset + SSO metadata
- Fri 5/14: baseline runs and first eval; we share raw latency/cost snapshot
- Mon 5/24: formal pilot acceptance review and decision window

If this looks good I'll convert this list into a short mutual action plan (MAP) and we can start provisioning Monday. Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

Thanks Tessa — this matches our notes. Quick confirmations and a couple of asks: 

1) We can commit to the timeline. Eli will send SAML metadata by EOD Tue 5/12.
2) We will upload a 10k-row synthetic dataset and the 500-prompt eval set to the Drive folder by Tue 5/12. Link will be shared once complete.
3) Security review: our security team (security@fathomdata.com) asked if Redwood can provide an audit log export sample and the retention policy for request-level logs during the pilot. Can Marcus or Priyom share that?
4) On quality metrics: we prefer a mix of automatic scoring + 100 manually annotated prompts to check edge cases. We'll provide the annotations after the first baseline run.

Also, please add our procurement contact (procure@fathomdata.com) to the loop for the pilot MOA.

Hannah
Director of ML Engineering
Fathom Data
